method: Differential slope tok/char: slope = (tokens(unit*b) - tokens(unit*a)) / (len(unit*b) - len(unit*a)), reps=[a,b], which cancels fixed endpoint overhead (chat template, hidden system prompt). Offline values computed with tiktoken 0.14.0 / tokenizers 0.23.3 / transformers 5.20.2 with special tokens disabled; ratios[class]=[min,max] over the family's tokenizers expanded by 5% each side (gemini +/-15%; claude hand-set from third-party measurements). 'measured' holds the raw per-tokenizer slopes (extra field, may be ignored).

en.unit: Notwithstanding the unprecedented electromagnetic interference, Dr. Hernandez's interdisciplinary team (22 researchers, 3 labs) re-calibrated the spectrophotometers; however, 87.5% of the measurements remained inconsistent. Cryptographic authentication isn't foolproof!

zh.unit: 今天天气很好，我们一起去公园散步，然后在附近的餐厅吃午饭。生活中的小事常常让人感到幸福，希望大家都能健康快乐地度过每一天。

openai.source: tiktoken 0.14.0 offline encodings o200k_base (gpt-4o/4.1/5 family) and cl100k_base (gpt-4/gpt-3.5); openai/gpt-oss-20b tokenizer.json (o200k_harmony) measured identical to o200k_base
openai.notes: Band spans both encodings; the zh gap (o200k 0.71 vs cl100k 1.29) makes the zh band wide. o1/o3/o4 also use o200k_base. Special tokens not counted (encode with disallowed_special=()).

deepseek.source: HuggingFace tokenizer.json of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3, V3.1, V3.2 via tokenizers lib; add_special_tokens=False
deepseek.notes: V3/V3.1/V3.2/R1 share one 128k vocab (measured identical on these 4 texts). Legacy deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2.5 (100k vocab, splits digits one by one) measured en 0.2074 zh 0.5161 code 0.3206 digits 1.0 and is NOT included in the band; an endpoint serving V2.x would fall outside the digits band.

qwen.source: HuggingFace tokenizer.json of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B
qwen.notes: Qwen2.5/Qwen3/Qwen3-Next identical on the 4 texts; Qwen3.5 has an extended vocab (slightly different zh/code). Splits digits one by one (digits ~1.0) which is the strongest discriminator vs o200k/deepseek/kimi/llama (0.333).

kimi.source: moonshotai/Kimi-K2-* tokenizers (tiktoken-based tokenization_kimi.py, loaded with transformers trust_remote_code=True)
kimi.notes: K2 Instruct / 0905 / Thinking / K2.5 measured identical on the 4 texts. Older Moonshot (moonshot-v1-*) models are not covered.

glm.source: HuggingFace tokenizers of THUDM/glm-4-9b-chat (trust_remote_code) and zai-org/GLM-4.5/4.6/4.7/5 (tokenizer.json)
glm.notes: All GLM-4.x/5 measured identical. Digits slope (0.6353) is specific to the fixed digit string because GLM merges multi-digit runs irregularly; do not change the digits text without recomputing.

llama.source: HuggingFace tokenizer.json from public mirrors (NousResearch / unsloth) of Llama-3, 3.2, 3.3 and Llama-4-Scout (gated meta-llama repos not used)
llama.notes: Llama-3.x share one 128k vocab; Llama-4 has a 202k vocab (lower zh). Llama-2 (sentencepiece 32k) not included. Hosted Llama endpoints usually serve 3.x or 4.

gemini.source: Approximation: Gemma SentencePiece tokenizers (unsloth mirrors). Google states Gemma uses a subset of Gemini's SentencePiece tokenizer (arXiv 2403.08295: splits digits, keeps whitespace); community gemini-tokenizer crate uses the Gemma3 model for all Gemini models. Google docs say ~4 chars/token for English (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/tokens).
gemini.notes: Not the real Gemini tokenizer; band expanded +/-15% instead of 5% to reflect approximation. Google's 4 chars/token English rule of thumb (0.25 tok/char) is above the measured gemma en slope (~0.20 on this rare-word-heavy text), so a real Gemini endpoint may sit above this band on en; treat en as weak evidence and rely on digits/zh/code.

claude.source: NOT computed. Anthropic publishes no tokenizer. Hand-set wide bands from third-party measurements via /v1/messages/count_tokens: claudecodecamp.com 2026-04-16 'I Measured Claude 4.7's New Tokenizer' (Claude 4.6 vs 4.7 tokens/char: English prose 0.231->0.278, technical docs 0.188->0.277, Python 0.271->0.349, Chinese prose 1.039->1.052, numeric CSV 0.528->0.567; single-shot counts incl. ~8 token message overhead); Sander Land 'On the Biology of Claude's Tokenizer' (tokencontributions.substack.com, 2026-07-29: Han chars tokenized one per token, digits in groups of 3, unofficial reverse engineering); Anthropic Opus 4.7 migration note: new tokenizer uses roughly 1.0-1.35x tokens vs previous.
claude.notes: Bands are deliberately wide and unverified against this skill's fixed texts; the Claude tokenizer changed between model generations (4.6 vs 4.7+ differ 1.0-1.47x on English/code, ~1.0x on CJK), so one family band must cover several tokenizers. digits band is inferred (groups of 3 -> 0.333; numeric CSV measured 0.53-0.57 including commas). Use only as weak evidence (e.g. 'Claude-like' vs 'digits~1.0 Qwen/Gemini-like'); do not claim exact match.
